tianxia.sphere.air.name: Air
tianxia.sphere.air.reality_principle: Freedom lives in breath, pressure, and movement.
tianxia.sphere.air.dao_trail: The character evades, redirects, rises, falls safely, uses unseen motion, and treats space as something to move through gracefully.
tianxia.sphere.air.trial_signs: Climbs by wind, escapes a trap by movement, protects breath, chooses mobility over position.
tianxia.sphere.air.shadow: Flightiness, avoidance, lack of commitment, or abandoning those who cannot keep up.
tianxia.sphere.air.keep_distinct_from: Weather is atmospheric system. Force is direct invisible pressure. Space skips distance. Air is breath, wind, movement, and pressure flow.
tianxia.sphere.air.gm_read: Air is freedom through breath and movement. It is tested by boundary, grounding, and danger that cannot simply be flown over.

tianxia.sphere.alchemy.name: Alchemy
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.reality_principle: Impurity and potential can be separated by refinement.
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.dao_trail: The character prepares, studies ingredients, accepts controlled risk, refines medicine, and turns raw materials into cultivated transformation.
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.trial_signs: Collects components, improves a flawed tool, chooses preparation over immediate glory, understands side effects.
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.shadow: Shortcuts, pill dependence, treating beings as ingredients, or believing refinement justifies any furnace.
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.keep_distinct_from: Talismans store commands in media. Formations arrange space. Poison exploits toxins. Life heals directly. Alchemy refines substances and cultivator potential.
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.path_pull: Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit or Body.
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.gm_read: Alchemy separates impurity from potential. It is tested by volatility, toxicity, and desire for shortcuts.

tianxia.sphere.ash.name: Ash
tianxia.sphere.ash.reality_principle: Every fire leaves a law of aftermath.
tianxia.sphere.ash.dao_trail: The character understands ruin, attrition, smothering, memory after destruction, and the power of what remains.
tianxia.sphere.ash.trial_signs: Studies the burned room, uses residue to track truth, smothers danger, accepts that some things cannot be restored.
tianxia.sphere.ash.shadow: Bitterness, spite, living only in aftermath, or denying renewal because something was lost.
tianxia.sphere.ash.keep_distinct_from: Fire is active burning. Smoke obstructs and drifts. Death governs mortality. Void governs absence. Ash is the settled memory of destruction.
tianxia.sphere.ash.gm_read: Ash is aftermath made into law. It is tested by renewal, dispersal, and joy after ruin.

tianxia.sphere.athletics.name: Athletics
tianxia.sphere.athletics.reality_principle: The body can answer the question terrain asks before the enemy understands it was asked.
tianxia.sphere.athletics.dao_trail: The character climbs, leaps, pursues, tumbles, and treats height, distance, and footing as choices rather than limits.
tianxia.sphere.athletics.trial_signs: Takes the wall instead of the stair, catches a fleeing rival, crosses the broken bridge by leaping, reaches the injured first.
tianxia.sphere.athletics.shadow: Restlessness, showing off, outrunning responsibility, or leaving behind those who cannot follow.
tianxia.sphere.athletics.keep_distinct_from: Air moves through breath and wind. Monkey Style moves to mock and disorder. Brute moves through obstacles by force. Athletics is trained bodily mobility over real terrain.
tianxia.sphere.athletics.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.athletics.gm_read: Athletics answers pressure with position the enemy did not expect. It is tested when the right answer is to stay, to carry others, or to enter danger that speed cannot outrun.
tianxia.sphere.athletics.basis: Compendium opening quote ("The battlefield is not a floor...") and Common Effects.

tianxia.sphere.axes.name: Axes
tianxia.sphere.axes.reality_principle: Whatever is joined can be split where its grain is weakest.
tianxia.sphere.axes.dao_trail: The character commits weight behind a short line, breaks shields and doors, hooks and drags, and looks for the root that brings the whole structure down.
tianxia.sphere.axes.trial_signs: Chops through the barred gate, hooks a rival's guard aside, fells the tree that bridges the ravine, breaks a formation panel at its seam.
tianxia.sphere.axes.shadow: Brutality, reducing every bond to something to sever, execution as pleasure, or splitting what should stay whole.
tianxia.sphere.axes.keep_distinct_from: Sword chooses a line of severance. Brute overpowers the obstacle. Destruction breaks through raw force. Unmaking dissolves cohesion itself. Axes hew along the grain of joined things.
tianxia.sphere.axes.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.axes.gm_read: Axes find the seam in joined things. It is tested by bonds that should not be cut, subtle influence that cannot be chopped, and danger with no grain to read.
tianxia.sphere.axes.basis: Compendium "Axes Dao" ("Axes ask what joined thing is ready to split").

tianxia.sphere.barrage.name: Barrage
tianxia.sphere.barrage.reality_principle: A defense proves itself only against the second blow.
tianxia.sphere.barrage.dao_trail: The character fills distance with pressure, suppresses rather than duels, follows every shot with another, and manages ammunition and angles.
tianxia.sphere.barrage.trial_signs: Pins a group behind cover with thrown stones, covers an ally's crossing with volleys, tests a guard with one shot and exploits the reaction with the next.
tianxia.sphere.barrage.shadow: Indiscriminate harm, waste, noise without purpose, or drowning a problem in force instead of understanding it.
tianxia.sphere.barrage.keep_distinct_from: Sniper proves distance with one correct line. Destruction breaks with single impact. Weather controls the whole field as a system. Barrage is sustained ranged pressure and suppression.
tianxia.sphere.barrage.path_pull: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.barrage.gm_read: Barrage makes pressure continuous. It is tested by restraint, scarcity, and situations where one precise answer matters more than many.
tianxia.sphere.barrage.basis: Compendium opening quote ("One projectile tests the defense...") and Common Effects.

tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.name: Beastmastery
tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.reality_principle: The self can grow through bond with another living will.
tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.dao_trail: The character respects instinct, forms mutual trust, reads nonhuman needs, coordinates with companions, and accepts that power may be shared.
tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.trial_signs: Calms a beast instead of killing it, offers food, reads tracks, protects an animal, follows instinct when reason fails.
tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.shadow: Treating companions as tools, dominance obsession, dependency, or hiding behind bonded creatures.
tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.keep_distinct_from: War commands troops. Spirit speaks with souls. Puppetry controls constructed agents. Beast Taming is mutual evolution through bond and instinct.
tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.path_pull: Spirit Awakening, Qi Cultivation, or Body Refining depending on version.
tianxia.sphere.beastmastery.gm_read: Beast Taming grows the self through bond with another will. It is tested when bond must not become dominance or dependency.

tianxia.sphere.beauty.name: Beauty
tianxia.sphere.beauty.reality_principle: What is whole can make even a blade hesitate.
tianxia.sphere.beauty.dao_trail: The character commands attention through poise and presence, turns hostility aside by making cruelty feel ugly, and honors the shape of things worth keeping.
tianxia.sphere.beauty.trial_signs: Stops a brawl by stepping into its center, makes a judge look twice, turns a scar into a vow, protects something fragile because it is beautiful.
tianxia.sphere.beauty.shadow: Vanity, seduction as control, cruelty toward the unlovely, or mistaking admiration for worth.
tianxia.sphere.beauty.keep_distinct_from: Flowers lure through bloom, fragrance, and delay. Illusion falsifies perception. Music moves hearts through rhythm. Radiance pressures through purity. Beauty is presence that makes harm hesitate.
tianxia.sphere.beauty.gm_read: Beauty is the moment the world remembers what should stay whole. It is tested by ugliness that must be faced, danger that does not care to look, and boundaries that presence cannot cross.
tianxia.sphere.beauty.basis: Compendium "Dao of Beauty" ("What does the heart refuse to harm?").

tianxia.sphere.berserker.name: Berserker
tianxia.sphere.berserker.reality_principle: Pain spent in full becomes strength the careful never reach.
tianxia.sphere.berserker.dao_trail: The character commits the whole body, fights through wounds, grows stronger as they are battered, and refuses to fall while the fight still matters.
tianxia.sphere.berserker.trial_signs: Keeps fighting while bleeding, charges the largest threat, shrugs off a blow meant to end them, carries on past exhaustion to finish the task.
tianxia.sphere.berserker.shadow: Rage without purpose, self-destruction, harming allies in frenzy, or needing violence to feel alive.
tianxia.sphere.berserker.keep_distinct_from: Brute trusts raw strength. Yang surges with vitality. Blood pays with life-force and lineage. Destruction seeks impact for its own sake. Berserker is total commitment that feeds on being hurt.
tianxia.sphere.berserker.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit through explicit synergy.
tianxia.sphere.berserker.gm_read: Berserker turns punishment into momentum. It is tested by restraint, by allies who need gentleness, and by moments when stopping is the braver act.
tianxia.sphere.berserker.basis: Compendium Sphere Type and Core Chassis (Adrenaline, Batter, Battered state, Exertion talents).

tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.reality_principle: A thing becomes itself only by passing through its ordeal.
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.dao_trail: The character reads flaws, improves what they are given, tempers under pressure, and asks what a tool is trying to become.
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.trial_signs: Repairs a broken weapon before a fight, finds the crack in a gate, sharpens an ally's blade, chooses patient work over a quick gift.
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.shadow: Perfectionism, treating people as workpieces, forcing a shape onto what resists, or valuing the made thing over its maker.
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.keep_distinct_from: Metal governs refined material and conductivity. Alchemy refines substances inside the body. Equipment wears protection well. Imbuement places a temporary command. Blacksmith is transformation through deliberate ordeal.
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.path_pull: Qi Cultivation and Body Refining, sometimes Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.gm_read: Blacksmith knows what a thing is trying to become and makes the world pay for that becoming. It is tested by haste, by materials that cannot be controlled, and by people who will not be shaped.
tianxia.sphere.blacksmith.basis: Compendium "Blacksmith Dao" ("the cultivation of the accepted ordeal").

tianxia.sphere.blood.name: Blood
tianxia.sphere.blood.reality_principle: Life-force carries identity, lineage, sacrifice, and debt.
tianxia.sphere.blood.dao_trail: The character pays with vitality, tracks wounds, honors kinship, protects through shared pain, or invokes inherited power.
tianxia.sphere.blood.trial_signs: Gives blood to seal a promise, follows an injury trail, stabilizes someone through their own vitality, reacts strongly to ancestry or sacrifice.
tianxia.sphere.blood.shadow: Predation, blood control, inherited supremacy, addiction to sacrifice, or treating lives as fuel.
tianxia.sphere.blood.keep_distinct_from: Life restores living systems. Flesh reshapes tissue. Disease spreads hostile patterns. Demonic Cultivation steals growth through corruption and souls.
tianxia.sphere.blood.path_pull: Qi Cultivation, Spirit Awakening, sometimes Body Refining.
tianxia.sphere.blood.gm_read: Blood carries vitality, lineage, sacrifice, and debt. It is tested by boundaries, social obligation, and sudden injury.

tianxia.sphere.brute.name: Brute
tianxia.sphere.brute.reality_principle: Obstacles are real, but the body can become more real.
tianxia.sphere.brute.dao_trail: The character meets resistance directly, trusts strength, accepts impact, and turns the environment into a weapon or tool.
tianxia.sphere.brute.trial_signs: Breaks a gate, carries others, shoves through danger, uses raw leverage, refuses to be stopped by pain.
tianxia.sphere.brute.shadow: Cruelty, stubbornness, humiliation of the weak, or treating every problem as something to smash.
tianxia.sphere.brute.keep_distinct_from: Guardian protects by becoming a boundary. Wrestling controls through contact. Earth endures as terrain and stability. Brute is embodied force and explosive confidence.
tianxia.sphere.brute.gm_read: Brute answers pressure by making the body more real than the obstacle. It is tested when strength must support, listen, or enter danger without a clear thing to smash.

tianxia.sphere.chains.name: Chains
tianxia.sphere.chains.reality_principle: Connection can rescue, restrain, anchor, or imprison.
tianxia.sphere.chains.dao_trail: The character binds threats, prevents falls, captures alive, links allies, anchors danger, and sees freedom as something that can be negotiated.
tianxia.sphere.chains.trial_signs: Tethers a falling candidate, chooses capture over killing, locks a door against a monster, binds themselves to another's fate.
tianxia.sphere.chains.shadow: Captivity, possessive control, safety through restriction, or fear of letting anything leave.
tianxia.sphere.chains.keep_distinct_from: Thread is subtle precision and hidden lines. Karma binds through consequence. Formations bind areas through rules. Chains are immediate links, restraint, and anchoring.
tianxia.sphere.chains.path_pull: Qi Cultivation, Body Refining, or Spirit Awakening.
tianxia.sphere.chains.gm_read: Chains turn connection into restraint or rescue. It is tested by freedom, subtle influence, and sudden rupture.

tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.name: Daemonic Cultivation
tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.reality_principle: Stolen growth is possible, and it always demands a price.
tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.dao_trail: The character accepts shortcuts, predation, soul hunger, forbidden bargains, corrupted power, and growth through devouring.
tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.trial_signs: Takes power from a defeated foe, chooses a forbidden answer, accepts visible corruption for immediate strength.
tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.shadow: Loss of humanity, addiction to theft, escalating corruption, becoming the appetite that once offered help.
tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.keep_distinct_from: Blood can be medicinal or sacrificial without being demonic. Death can be orthodox. Void erases. Disease corrupts patterns. Demonic Cultivation is predatory stolen ascent.
tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.path_pull: Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening, rare Body expression.
tianxia.sphere.daemonic_cultivation.gm_read: Demonic Cultivation is stolen growth with a price. It is tested by humility, purification, and restraint.

tianxia.sphere.dark.name: Dark
tianxia.sphere.dark.reality_principle: The unseen has power because it cannot be claimed.
tianxia.sphere.dark.dao_trail: The character hides, isolates, moves through obscurity, invokes fear of the unknown, and protects secrets.
tianxia.sphere.dark.trial_signs: Uses unlit routes, frightens a pursuer, shields someone by removing visibility, accepts not being seen.
tianxia.sphere.dark.shadow: Secrecy, terror, predation, or believing truth only survives in darkness.
tianxia.sphere.dark.keep_distinct_from: Shadow uses cast shapes and angles. Yin is stillness and quiet endings. Illusion creates false perception. Smoke physically obstructs. Darkness is supernatural obscurity and the unseen.
tianxia.sphere.dark.gm_read: Darkness protects or threatens through the unseen. It is tested by exposure, community, and authority.

tianxia.sphere.death.name: Death
tianxia.sphere.death.reality_principle: Endings are a law, not a failure.
tianxia.sphere.death.dao_trail: The character respects mortality, corpses, grave energy, funeral rites, withering, and boundaries between life and death.
tianxia.sphere.death.trial_signs: Gives burial, speaks to ancestral remains, stops false regeneration, accepts that something must end.
tianxia.sphere.death.shadow: Nihilism, necromantic exploitation, contempt for the living, or using death as aesthetic power without reverence.
tianxia.sphere.death.keep_distinct_from: Spirit governs souls. Disease governs sickness. Yin governs quiet endings and suppression. Void governs absence. Death governs mortality, corpses, decay, and the final threshold.
tianxia.sphere.death.gm_read: Death treats endings as law. It is tested by revelation, social grief, and renewal.

tianxia.sphere.destruction.name: Destruction
tianxia.sphere.destruction.reality_principle: Sometimes power is the answer, and the answer is impact.
tianxia.sphere.destruction.dao_trail: The character breaks defenses, ends threats directly, accepts violent force, and trusts overwhelming output.
tianxia.sphere.destruction.trial_signs: Blasts through the wall, destroys the source of danger, chooses the attack that prevents prolonged suffering.
tianxia.sphere.destruction.shadow: Collateral damage, impatience, addiction to simple answers, or inability to build after breaking.
tianxia.sphere.destruction.keep_distinct_from: Fire burns. Force pushes and shields. Void nullifies. Magma controls heavy hazard terrain. Destruction is direct cultivated damage and breaking power.
tianxia.sphere.destruction.gm_read: Destruction is direct cultivated impact. It is tested by support, restraint, and subtle solutions.

tianxia.sphere.disease.name: Disease
tianxia.sphere.disease.dao_trail: The character diagnoses systems, controls infection, exploits vulnerability, builds immunity, quarantines danger, or weaponizes symptoms.
tianxia.sphere.disease.trial_signs: Spots contagion, isolates a threat, treats one person to protect many, recognizes corruption as a spreading pattern.
tianxia.sphere.disease.shadow: Cruelty through contagion, viewing people as carriers, justifying harm as containment.
tianxia.sphere.disease.keep_distinct_from: Poison is toxin and dose. Death is ending. Flesh is tissue. Flowers can use pollen and medicine. Demonic Cultivation corrupts through stolen growth and forbidden hunger.
tianxia.sphere.disease.gm_read: Disease is weakness spreading through patterns. It is tested by diagnosis, containment, and social spread.

tianxia.sphere.dreams.name: Dreams
tianxia.sphere.dreams.reality_principle: The sleeping self is also real.
tianxia.sphere.dreams.dao_trail: The character works through symbols, nightmares, subconscious truth, dream travel, emotional recovery, and visions.
tianxia.sphere.dreams.trial_signs: Understands a symbolic test, enters another's nightmare, heals through rest, receives meaning from impossible imagery.
tianxia.sphere.dreams.shadow: Escapism, invasion of vulnerability, confusing symbol with consent, or trapping others in comforting lies.
tianxia.sphere.dreams.keep_distinct_from: Mind touches waking thought. Illusion alters senses. Spirit deals with souls. Moon governs sleep cycles and phases. Dreams govern subconscious reality and symbolic memory.
tianxia.sphere.dreams.gm_read: Dreams make the sleeping self real. It is tested by waking boundaries, authority, and shock.

tianxia.sphere.drunken_style.name: Drunken Style
tianxia.sphere.drunken_style.reality_principle: Imbalance can be refined into its own kind of momentum.
tianxia.sphere.drunken_style.dao_trail: The character turns falls, mistakes, knockback, low stances, and unstable angles into motion and attack.
tianxia.sphere.drunken_style.trial_signs: Rolls under danger, wins while prone, uses a stumble as entry, turns being shoved into a counter.
tianxia.sphere.drunken_style.shadow: Self-destruction, drunken evasion, romanticizing instability, or refusing to build any stable center.
tianxia.sphere.drunken_style.keep_distinct_from: Flowing River redirects with grace. Monkey Style disrupts with playful chaos. Reeling Immortal cultivates the moment when apparent failure becomes motion.
tianxia.sphere.drunken_style.gm_read: Reeling Immortal refines imbalance into momentum. It is tested when instability must become art instead of self-destruction.

tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.name: Dual Wielding
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.reality_principle: One decision can arrive from two directions at once.
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.dao_trail: The character pairs threat with answer, lets one hand occupy while the other finds the opening, and fights through multiple angles without losing a single intent.
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.trial_signs: Blocks and strikes in one motion, handles two problems at once, feints with one hand and acts with the other, adapts mid-exchange.
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.shadow: Divided loyalty, doing two things badly, restless excess, or never committing fully to either hand.
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.keep_distinct_from: Scoundrel exploits openings with any tool. Retribution waits for the enemy's commitment. Sabers commits to one brutal line. Dual Wielding is paired intent: question and answer from two sides.
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.gm_read: Dual Wielding asks a question with one weapon and punishes the answer with the other. It is tested by stillness, by single-minded opponents, and by moments that need one clean commitment.
tianxia.sphere.dual_wielding.basis: Compendium "Dual Wielding Dao" ("the cultivation of paired intent").

tianxia.sphere.earth.name: Earth
tianxia.sphere.earth.reality_principle: What is rooted cannot be easily moved.
tianxia.sphere.earth.dao_trail: The character values stability, fortification, patience, territory, endurance, and practical support.
tianxia.sphere.earth.trial_signs: Builds cover, holds a slope, chooses the slow secure route, anchors others, makes shelter from hostile terrain.
tianxia.sphere.earth.shadow: Stagnation, possessiveness, territorial control, or refusing necessary change.
tianxia.sphere.earth.keep_distinct_from: Brute is body force. Metal is refined material. Gravity is weight and attraction. Wood is living growth. Earth is ground, stone, and staying power.
tianxia.sphere.earth.gm_read: Earth is staying power. It is tested by penetration, shock, and hidden danger below the stable surface.

tianxia.sphere.equipment.name: Equipment
tianxia.sphere.equipment.reality_principle: Protection is a discipline, not a shell.
tianxia.sphere.equipment.dao_trail: The character prepares, maintains gear, fits burden to breath, and treats readiness as a daily practice rather than a hope.
tianxia.sphere.equipment.trial_signs: Arrives armored and rested, checks straps before danger, lends gear to the unprepared, keeps moving under heavy load.
tianxia.sphere.equipment.shadow: Hiding inside armor, rank worship, reliance on gear over skill, or refusing to go where gear cannot follow.
tianxia.sphere.equipment.keep_distinct_from: Guardian puts the self in harm's way. Shield actively meets the blow. Protection builds barriers. Blacksmith makes the gear. Equipment is the practice of wearing protection well.
tianxia.sphere.equipment.path_pull: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.equipment.gm_read: Equipment wears protection without being ruled by it. It is tested by speed, by hidden danger that armor cannot see, and by moments that ask the body to act without its shell.
tianxia.sphere.equipment.basis: Compendium "Equipment Dao" ("wearing protection without being ruled by it").

tianxia.sphere.fate.name: Fate
tianxia.sphere.fate.reality_principle: Possibility has currents before it hardens into event.
tianxia.sphere.fate.dao_trail: The character trusts coincidence, reads openings, accepts risk, nudges probability, and recognizes auspicious or doomed moments.
tianxia.sphere.fate.trial_signs: Bets on the one unlikely route, notices a repeated omen, turns a failure into a lucky opening.
tianxia.sphere.fate.shadow: Gambling with lives, refusing responsibility, fatalism, or believing luck absolves choice.
tianxia.sphere.fate.keep_distinct_from: Divination reads signs. Karma answers deeds. Time alters sequence. Stars orient destiny through distant pattern. Fate governs uncertain possibility and strange timing.
tianxia.sphere.fate.gm_read: Fate moves in the uncertain space before event becomes fact. It is tested by agency, fixed boundaries, and clear evidence.

tianxia.sphere.fire.name: Fire
tianxia.sphere.fire.reality_principle: Change is heat, hunger, and purification.
tianxia.sphere.fire.dao_trail: The character ignites action, burns corruption, accepts risk, moves aggressively, and forces transformation through heat.
tianxia.sphere.fire.trial_signs: Lights the way, burns poison away, charges before fear settles, chooses cleansing flame despite danger.
tianxia.sphere.fire.shadow: Rage, impatience, consuming what should be saved, or calling every appetite purification.
tianxia.sphere.fire.keep_distinct_from: Yang is vitality and active life-force. Sun is sovereign solar pressure. Ash is aftermath. Magma is molten earth and heavy volcanic force.
tianxia.sphere.fire.gm_read: Fire forces change through heat and risk. It is tested by danger, stillness, and receptivity.

tianxia.sphere.flowers.name: Flowers
tianxia.sphere.flowers.reality_principle: Beauty is timing, fragrance, lure, bloom, and poison.
tianxia.sphere.flowers.dao_trail: The character uses elegance, emotional influence, patience, delayed effects, healing beauty, and subtle danger.
tianxia.sphere.flowers.trial_signs: Calms with fragrance, hides a solution in beauty, waits for a delayed bloom, uses gentleness as a trap or cure.
tianxia.sphere.flowers.shadow: Vanity, seduction, slow cruelty, or valuing appearances over roots.
tianxia.sphere.flowers.keep_distinct_from: Wood is roots, trees, and long growth. Poison is toxins. Life restores bodies. Illusion deceives senses. Flowers are brief beauty, emotion, pollen, and patient influence.
tianxia.sphere.flowers.gm_read: Flowers make beauty, timing, and subtle influence dangerous. It is tested by restraint, hidden peril, and authority.

tianxia.sphere.flowing_river.name: Flowing River
tianxia.sphere.flowing_river.reality_principle: Force does not need to be opposed when it can be redirected.
tianxia.sphere.flowing_river.dao_trail: The character yields without surrendering, borrows momentum, moves around impact, and turns an enemy's strength into the answer.
tianxia.sphere.flowing_river.trial_signs: Lets a trap spend itself, redirects a charging beast, solves conflict by movement, guides danger elsewhere.
tianxia.sphere.flowing_river.shadow: Avoidance, endless deflection, refusing to commit, or manipulating others by never standing firm.
tianxia.sphere.flowing_river.keep_distinct_from: Water is elemental flow and cleansing. Guardian stops harm. Wrestling locks bodies. Flowing River is martial redirection through posture, timing, and soft control.
tianxia.sphere.flowing_river.gm_read: Flowing River answers force by changing its direction. It matures when yielding does not become avoidance and redirection does not become manipulation.

tianxia.sphere.force.name: Force
tianxia.sphere.force.reality_principle: Will can press on the world without touching it.
tianxia.sphere.force.dao_trail: The character makes barriers, pushes, pulls, shields, lifts, and solves problems through invisible direct pressure.
tianxia.sphere.force.trial_signs: Holds a door shut from afar, catches someone with unseen force, creates a barrier, moves objects without contact.
tianxia.sphere.force.shadow: Blunt coercion, emotional distance, treating consent as another surface to push.
tianxia.sphere.force.keep_distinct_from: Gravity governs weight and falling. Air governs breath and wind. Space governs distance. Destruction governs damage. Force is direct invisible contact.
tianxia.sphere.force.gm_read: Force is will touching the world invisibly. It is tested by subtlety, support, and exchange.

tianxia.sphere.formations.name: Formations
tianxia.sphere.formations.reality_principle: Place becomes law when lines are properly anchored.
tianxia.sphere.formations.dao_trail: The character prepares arrays, marks territory, controls zones, builds defenses, and thinks through structure before crisis.
tianxia.sphere.formations.trial_signs: Places markers, reads a floor pattern, turns a room into a rule, protects a location through preparation.
tianxia.sphere.formations.shadow: Overplanning, territorial entrapment, fear of improvisation, or forcing people to live inside a pattern.
tianxia.sphere.formations.keep_distinct_from: Talismans are portable prepared effects. Ink marks and revises through script. War directs living troops. Space breaks distance. Formations make area and flow obey arrangement.
tianxia.sphere.formations.path_pull: Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit or Body.
tianxia.sphere.formations.gm_read: Formations make place obey pattern. It is tested by disruption, hidden flaws, and authority that tries to override the array.

tianxia.sphere.glass.name: Glass
tianxia.sphere.glass.reality_principle: Clarity can cut precisely because it can break.
tianxia.sphere.glass.dao_trail: The character uses transparency, lenses, reflections, brittle barriers, sharp fragments, and fragile precision.
tianxia.sphere.glass.trial_signs: Reveals a hidden line of sight, turns a window into a weapon, traps with transparent walls, accepts fragility for precision.
tianxia.sphere.glass.shadow: Fragility hidden as elegance, vanity, self-harm through brittleness, or trusting appearances too much.
tianxia.sphere.glass.keep_distinct_from: Crystal is durable resonance. Mirrors are symbolic reflection. Light is visibility and optics. Sand is unrefined particulate. Glass is fragile clarity and cutting surface.
tianxia.sphere.glass.gm_read: Glass is fragile clarity. It is tested by hidden danger, shock, and the need for support.

tianxia.sphere.gravity.name: Gravity
tianxia.sphere.gravity.reality_principle: Every body is bound by attraction, burden, and fall.
tianxia.sphere.gravity.dao_trail: The character manipulates weight, pressure, falling, orbit, flight denial, and the emotional meaning of burden.
tianxia.sphere.gravity.trial_signs: Pins a threat, lightens an ally, drops a monster, uses weight to reveal weakness.
tianxia.sphere.gravity.shadow: Crushing control, making others carry the cultivator's weight, or treating freedom as a flight to be denied.
tianxia.sphere.gravity.keep_distinct_from: Force is direct invisible pressure. Earth is mass and ground. Space is distance. Air is flight and breath. Gravity is weight, relation, falling, and attraction.
tianxia.sphere.gravity.gm_read: Gravity is burden, relation, attraction, and fall. It is tested by movement, sudden action, and openness.

tianxia.sphere.guardian.name: Guardian
tianxia.sphere.guardian.reality_principle: The self can become a wall between harm and what matters.
tianxia.sphere.guardian.dao_trail: The character interposes, accepts pain, holds ground, and treats protection as action rather than hesitation.
tianxia.sphere.guardian.trial_signs: Shields a weaker candidate, holds a door, takes the dangerous position, refuses to abandon a fallen ally.
tianxia.sphere.guardian.shadow: Martyrdom, possessive protection, denying others agency, or confusing safety with control.
tianxia.sphere.guardian.keep_distinct_from: Earth holds territory. Life restores. Karma answers harm later. Guardian protects now by putting the body or will in the path of danger.
tianxia.sphere.guardian.gm_read: Guardian makes protection active. It is tested when the right protection requires trust, movement, or letting others stand with them.

tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.name: Harvesting Gathering
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.reality_principle: The land gives freely only to the hand that knows when to take.
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.dao_trail: The character reads signs, waits for ripeness, takes only what is needed, preserves what was taken, and tends the places that provide.
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.trial_signs: Finds the herb others missed, refuses to strip a grove bare, preserves a beast core properly, knows which berry is poison.
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.shadow: Greed, hoarding, stripping the land, or treating every living thing as a resource.
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.keep_distinct_from: Alchemy refines what is gathered. Verdant Growth grows the living world. Hunger consumes essence. Source reads buried origin. Harvesting and Gathering is patient, respectful taking.
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.path_pull: Any Path; Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening at higher Realms.
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.gm_read: Harvesting and Gathering knows what the land will give and when. It is tested by urgency, by command that demands too much, and by danger hidden in the harvest.
tianxia.sphere.harvesting_gathering.basis: Compendium opening quote ("The mountain gives nothing twice to the hand that tears") and Common Effects.

tianxia.sphere.hunger.name: Hunger
tianxia.sphere.hunger.reality_principle: Need is the engine of change; what is taken in becomes the self.
tianxia.sphere.hunger.dao_trail: The character tastes, refines, and digests essence, turns consumption into strength, and must decide what they will never eat.
tianxia.sphere.hunger.trial_signs: Eats the strange fruit, survives famine, shares a meal with enemies, refuses to devour what would make them less human.
tianxia.sphere.hunger.shadow: Gluttony, cannibal cultivation, becoming what one eats, or treating other cultivators as ingredients.
tianxia.sphere.hunger.keep_distinct_from: Daemonic Cultivation steals growth from others. Alchemy refines medicine outside the body. Harvesting gathers. Poison harms through dose. Hunger is consumption made into cultivation.
tianxia.sphere.hunger.path_pull: Body Refining and Spirit Awakening, sometimes Qi.
tianxia.sphere.hunger.gm_read: Hunger asks what an essence wants to become inside the cultivator. It is tested by restraint, by exposure of what was eaten, and by the shared table.
tianxia.sphere.hunger.basis: Compendium "Hunger Dao" ("the Dao of need becoming motion").

tianxia.sphere.ice.name: Ice
tianxia.sphere.ice.reality_principle: Motion can be slowed until truth is preserved or killed.
tianxia.sphere.ice.dao_trail: The character uses patience, suppression, preservation, brittle defenses, and the power of denying momentum.
tianxia.sphere.ice.trial_signs: Freezes a hazard, waits out panic, preserves evidence, slows a stronger threat instead of overpowering it.
tianxia.sphere.ice.shadow: Emotional numbness, cruelty through delay, refusing warmth, or mistaking stillness for wisdom.
tianxia.sphere.ice.keep_distinct_from: Yin is cosmic stillness and quiet endings. Water flows and cleanses. Death ends life. Crystal structures. Cold freezes, slows, preserves, and makes brittle.
tianxia.sphere.ice.gm_read: Cold denies momentum. It is tested by warmth, sudden action, and social life.

tianxia.sphere.illusion.name: Illusion
tianxia.sphere.illusion.reality_principle: Perception is an entrance to reality, not reality itself.
tianxia.sphere.illusion.dao_trail: The character misdirects, reframes, creates false sensory information, and understands that belief shapes action.
tianxia.sphere.illusion.trial_signs: Makes a fake route, hides truth with appearance, defeats a stronger foe by changing what they think they know.
tianxia.sphere.illusion.shadow: Lies, denial, identity manipulation, or living so long in fiction that truth becomes inconvenient.
tianxia.sphere.illusion.keep_distinct_from: Mind touches thought directly. Dreams move through subconscious symbols. Mirrors reveal through reflection. Light manipulates visibility. Illusion controls sensory reality and interpretation.
tianxia.sphere.illusion.gm_read: Illusion tests the entrance between perception and truth. It is tested by boundary, hidden peril, and command.

tianxia.sphere.imbuement.name: Imbuement
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.reality_principle: A thing is what the right command makes it remember.
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.dao_trail: The character commands objects and vessels, reinforces tools, silences or quickens what they touch, and sees every thing as holding a nature that can be called forth.
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.trial_signs: Makes a rope hold beyond its strength, silences a creaking gate, sharpens an ally's weapon with a touch, animates an object to help.
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.shadow: Control over everything touched, treating people as vessels, or commands that outlast their right.
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.keep_distinct_from: Blacksmith changes a thing through ordeal. Talismans store a command for later. Puppetry animates agents. Qiweaving retunes technique patterns. Imbuement places a brief command into a vessel's nature.
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.path_pull: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening; Body Refining through worn and held gear.
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.gm_read: Imbuement is temporary authority over what a thing is. It is tested by things that resist command, by commands fading at the wrong moment, and by vessels that are people.
tianxia.sphere.imbuement.basis: Compendium "Imbuement Dao" ("temporary authority over a vessel's nature").

tianxia.sphere.ink.name: Ink
tianxia.sphere.ink.reality_principle: Naming, drawing, and recording can revise the world.
tianxia.sphere.ink.dao_trail: The character writes seals, paints constructs, records truth, marks targets, and believes a correct sign can correct reality.
tianxia.sphere.ink.trial_signs: Draws a door, writes a binding mark, preserves a forbidden name, notices the missing character in an inscription.
tianxia.sphere.ink.shadow: Forging truth, bureaucratic control of reality, trapping living things in labels.
tianxia.sphere.ink.keep_distinct_from: Talismans store discrete effects. Formations anchor zones. Illusion creates appearances. Karma records consequence. Ink is living script, mark, image, and correction.
tianxia.sphere.ink.gm_read: Ink revises reality through sign and image. It is tested by interpretation, hidden meaning, and authority over the written truth.

tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.name: Iron Fist
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.reality_principle: The body is already a complete weapon; the empty hand is never empty.
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.dao_trail: The character trains the whole body, closes distance, reads where structure is weak, and chains stance, breath, and strike into one rhythm.
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.trial_signs: Disarms an armed rival barehanded, breaks a board with correct form, stays inside an opponent's guard, keeps discipline under pain.
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.shadow: Contempt for the untrained, needless brutality, obsession with mastery, or treating every body as a structure to break.
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.keep_distinct_from: Brute moves weight with raw force. Wrestling controls at the point of contact. Pressure Points finds the hinge with a finger. Iron Fist is the disciplined whole-body strike.
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.gm_read: Iron Fist strikes the body through the place least prepared to remain whole. It is tested by subtle influence, hidden danger, and exchanges that the fist cannot settle.
tianxia.sphere.iron_fist.basis: Compendium "Iron Fist Dao" ("the cultivation of the body as a complete weapon").

tianxia.sphere.jester.name: Jester
tianxia.sphere.jester.reality_principle: Truth passes through guarded doors when it wears the shape of a joke.
tianxia.sphere.jester.dao_trail: The character baits, mocks, feigns weakness, imitates, and speaks truth indirectly, letting arrogance expose itself.
tianxia.sphere.jester.trial_signs: Makes a proud elder laugh at themselves, pretends to fail to draw an enemy out, mocks the bully rather than the victim, escapes with a pratfall.
tianxia.sphere.jester.shadow: Cruel ridicule, contempt dressed as humor, never being sincere, or mocking identity instead of arrogance.
tianxia.sphere.jester.keep_distinct_from: Monkey Style makes the body chaotic. Scoundrel exploits practical openings. Illusion falsifies perception. Jester makes pride reveal itself.
tianxia.sphere.jester.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.jester.gm_read: Jester appears harmless because enemies reveal more to the fool. It is tested by authority that does not laugh, by grief that needs sincerity, and by danger that jokes cannot deflect.
tianxia.sphere.jester.basis: Compendium "Jester Dao" ("the cultivation of the crooked answer").

tianxia.sphere.karma.name: Karma
tianxia.sphere.karma.reality_principle: Every action leaves debt, grace, and consequence.
tianxia.sphere.karma.dao_trail: The character remembers deeds, binds oaths, repays harm, rewards sacrifice, judges broken promises, and waits for actions to ripen.
tianxia.sphere.karma.trial_signs: Marks a betrayal, protects someone because of a debt, refuses clean victory until consequence is answered.
tianxia.sphere.karma.shadow: Self-righteous punishment, entangling every bond, weaponizing morality, or confusing vengeance with balance.
tianxia.sphere.karma.keep_distinct_from: Fate governs possibility. Divination reads. Time sequences events. Thread connects physically or spiritually. Karma is consequence made visible and payable.
tianxia.sphere.karma.gm_read: Karma makes consequence visible and payable. It is tested by sudden return, hidden debt, and subtle connections.

tianxia.sphere.life.name: Life
tianxia.sphere.life.reality_principle: Living systems seek continuity, repair, and flourishing.
tianxia.sphere.life.dao_trail: The character preserves, heals, stabilizes, restores, nurtures, and treats survival as sacred work.
tianxia.sphere.life.trial_signs: Saves a stranger, tends infection, protects a wounded creature, chooses repair over victory.
tianxia.sphere.life.shadow: Refusing necessary endings, controlling others for their own good, or preserving life without asking what life is becoming.
tianxia.sphere.life.keep_distinct_from: Flowers heal through bloom, fragrance, and emotion. Wood grows ecosystems. Flesh reshapes tissue. Yang surges vitality. Life restores and sustains living systems.
tianxia.sphere.life.path_pull: Qi Cultivation, Spirit Awakening, sometimes Body Refining.
tianxia.sphere.life.gm_read: Life preserves living systems. It is tested by crisis, hidden danger, and the boundary where healing must accept limits.

tianxia.sphere.lightning.name: Lightning
tianxia.sphere.lightning.dao_trail: The character acts fast, chains consequences, disrupts nerves, takes bold risks, and turns delay into defeat.
tianxia.sphere.lightning.trial_signs: Crosses the gap first, interrupts a ritual, connects two hazards, strikes before fear can form.
tianxia.sphere.lightning.shadow: Impulsiveness, volatility, escalation, or burning every bridge through speed.
tianxia.sphere.lightning.keep_distinct_from: Weather creates storm systems. Air moves and redirects. Light governs visibility and beams. Sound governs thunder and vibration. Lightning is speed, shock, and conductive decision.
tianxia.sphere.lightning.gm_read: Lightning is sudden decision and conductive consequence. It is tested by stillness, grounding, and hidden danger.

tianxia.sphere.magma.name: Magma
tianxia.sphere.magma.reality_principle: Deep pressure beneath stillness eventually erupts.
tianxia.sphere.magma.dao_trail: The character uses heavy heat, siege pressure, molten terrain, slow unstoppable threat, and volcanic transformation.
tianxia.sphere.magma.trial_signs: Turns ground hostile, waits until pressure breaks, destroys fortifications, accepts dangerous ground to control the field.
tianxia.sphere.magma.shadow: Resentment, unstoppable harm once triggered, destroying escape routes for everyone.
tianxia.sphere.magma.keep_distinct_from: Fire is quick flame and ignition. Earth is stable stone. Ash is what remains. Metal refines through forge. Magma is molten terrain, eruption, and heavy hazard.
tianxia.sphere.magma.gm_read: Magma is deep pressure becoming molten action. It is tested by cooling danger, venting, and community that must survive its heat.

tianxia.sphere.metal.name: Metal
tianxia.sphere.metal.reality_principle: Refinement makes strength precise, durable, and useful.
tianxia.sphere.metal.dao_trail: The character values tools, armor, weapons, magnets, reforging, discipline, and material perfection.
tianxia.sphere.metal.trial_signs: Repairs a weapon, shapes armor, exploits conductivity, chooses the crafted solution over raw force.
tianxia.sphere.metal.shadow: Inflexibility, cold utility, treating people as tools, or mistaking refinement for worth.
tianxia.sphere.metal.keep_distinct_from: Sword is will and severance. Earth is raw mineral and terrain. Crystal is lattice resonance. Glass is brittle clarity. Metal is forged durability and useful form.
tianxia.sphere.metal.gm_read: Metal is useful strength made precise. It is tested by flexibility, exchange, and corrosion or hidden peril.

tianxia.sphere.monkey_style.name: Monkey Style
tianxia.sphere.monkey_style.reality_principle: Disorder reveals how brittle false order really is.
tianxia.sphere.monkey_style.dao_trail: The character climbs, mocks, tricks, scrambles, improvises, and wins by making the situation less predictable.
tianxia.sphere.monkey_style.trial_signs: Solves a test sideways, steals the key, uses the ceiling, laughs under pressure, defeats pompous rules through absurd movement.
tianxia.sphere.monkey_style.shadow: Irresponsibility, humiliation for its own sake, chaos addiction, or refusal to respect real danger.
tianxia.sphere.monkey_style.keep_distinct_from: Scoundrel exploits practical openings. Illusion changes perception. Monkey Style makes the body and battlefield behave like a joke with teeth.
tianxia.sphere.monkey_style.gm_read: Monkey Style breaks false order through embodied chaos. It is tested by stillness, authority, and danger that cannot be solved by clowning around.

tianxia.sphere.music.name: Music
tianxia.sphere.music.reality_principle: Rhythm moves bodies and hearts before thought can defend itself.
tianxia.sphere.music.dao_trail: The character coordinates others, reads emotional tempo, strengthens morale, disrupts fear, or uses cadence to control action.
tianxia.sphere.music.trial_signs: Leads a chant, steadies a panicked group, finds the rhythm of a trap, uses sound to guide allies in darkness.
tianxia.sphere.music.shadow: Emotional manipulation, cultic control, vanity, or making others perform a role for the cultivator's composition.
tianxia.sphere.music.keep_distinct_from: Sound is vibration and sonic force. Mind directly touches thought. War issues command. Music organizes emotion, timing, and shared motion.
tianxia.sphere.music.path_pull: Spirit Awakening, Qi Cultivation, or Body Refining depending on version.
tianxia.sphere.music.gm_read: Music shapes rhythm before thought can defend itself. It is tested by silence, fear, and authority that tries to command without resonance.

tianxia.sphere.poison.name: Poison
tianxia.sphere.poison.reality_principle: The smallest corruption can decide the strongest body.
tianxia.sphere.poison.dao_trail: The character uses patience, contamination, antidotes, delayed harm, weakness, and precise biological threat.
tianxia.sphere.poison.trial_signs: Identifies a toxin, doses a stronger foe, uses a small flaw to win, prepares an antidote before the trial turns.
tianxia.sphere.poison.shadow: Cowardly cruelty, paranoia, slow murder, or seeing all relationships as contamination vectors.
tianxia.sphere.poison.keep_distinct_from: Disease spreads hostile patterns. Alchemy refines medicines and pills. Flowers carries beauty, fragrance, and pollen. Blood governs vitality and lineage.
tianxia.sphere.poison.gm_read: Poison is small cause becoming decisive harm or antidote. It is tested by diagnosis, healing support, and containment.

tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.name: Pressure Points
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.reality_principle: Every structure has a hinge, and a finger can find it.
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.dao_trail: The character studies the body's weak points, prefers disabling over killing, disrupts breath, grip, and stance, and ends fights with precision.
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.trial_signs: Stops a brawler with a touch, releases a seized ally, knows where a wound will bleed, takes a rival down without harming them.
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.shadow: Cold clinical cruelty, torture through knowledge, or treating living bodies as mechanisms.
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.keep_distinct_from: Iron Fist strikes with the whole body. Wrestling controls at the point of contact. The Piercing Needle measures the duel. Disease exploits weakness through spreading patterns. Pressure Points finds the hinge of a living body.
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.path_pull: Body Refining and Spirit Awakening, sometimes Qi.
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.gm_read: Pressure Points wins by precision, not force. It is tested by raw overwhelming force, sudden chaos, and exposure where knowledge becomes cruelty.
tianxia.sphere.pressure_points.basis: Compendium opening quote ("A fist may break the door. A finger finds the hinge.") and Common Effects.

tianxia.sphere.protection.name: Protection
tianxia.sphere.protection.reality_principle: A barrier is a promise that what lies behind it will endure.
tianxia.sphere.protection.dao_trail: The character raises wards, shelters others, controls thresholds, and gives up their own safety so that others remain.
tianxia.sphere.protection.trial_signs: Builds shelter for the group, seals a doorway against a monster, takes a curse meant for another, holds a threshold.
tianxia.sphere.protection.shadow: Smothering safety, isolating others behind walls, self-sacrifice as control, or refusing to let anyone face risk.
tianxia.sphere.protection.keep_distinct_from: Guardian puts the body in harm's way. Shield actively meets the blow. Formations make place obey pattern. Earth fortifies terrain. Protection makes barriers and aegises that preserve what is behind them.
tianxia.sphere.protection.gm_read: Protection is a promise that something will survive. It is tested by sudden breach, by trust that asks for open doors, and by danger already inside the walls.
tianxia.sphere.protection.basis: Compendium opening quote ("A wall is not merely what refuses the enemy...") and Common Effects.

tianxia.sphere.puppetry.name: Puppetry
tianxia.sphere.puppetry.reality_principle: Agency can be housed, copied, delegated, or displaced.
tianxia.sphere.puppetry.dao_trail: The character uses proxies, remote action, constructed servants, layered plans, and risk management through controlled bodies.
tianxia.sphere.puppetry.trial_signs: Sends a puppet through danger, builds a decoy, treats battlefield presence as something that can be distributed.
tianxia.sphere.puppetry.shadow: Dehumanization, control addiction, hiding from consequence, or treating people as replaceable dolls.
tianxia.sphere.puppetry.keep_distinct_from: Beast Taming bonds with living wills. Thread controls lines. Spirit possession involves souls. Formations control places. Puppetry creates and commands agents.
tianxia.sphere.puppetry.path_pull: Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening, rare Body expression.
tianxia.sphere.puppetry.gm_read: Puppetry houses or displaces agency. It is tested by personal responsibility, relationship, and fear of direct risk.

tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.name: Qiweaving
tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.reality_principle: Every technique is a pattern held together, and patterns can be retuned.
tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.dao_trail: The character reads the current behind others' techniques, unweaves hostile workings, binds allies' qi, and respects the source Dao while changing its flow.
tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.trial_signs: Disrupts a rival's technique mid-cast, stabilizes a collapsing array, shares their qi with an exhausted ally, notices how a working is built.
tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.shadow: Meddling, stealing others' techniques, destabilizing for its own sake, or believing understanding a pattern means owning it.
tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.keep_distinct_from: Void nullifies. Formations anchor place. Imbuement commands vessels. Thread uses physical lines. Qiweaving retunes the currents that hold technique together.
tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.gm_read: Qiweaving sees the braided current behind every technique. It is tested by raw force without pattern, by sudden disruption, and by boundaries it has no right to cross.
tianxia.sphere.qiweaving.basis: Compendium "Qiweaving Dao" ("the cultivation of the pattern beneath technique").

tianxia.sphere.radiance.name: Radiance
tianxia.sphere.radiance.reality_principle: Spiritual brilliance reveals, purifies, and pressures the unclean.
tianxia.sphere.radiance.dao_trail: The character uses sacred light, cleansing force, revelation, moral pressure, and luminous presence.
tianxia.sphere.radiance.trial_signs: Purges a taint, reveals hidden corruption, stands openly against fear, burns away a curse with brilliance.
tianxia.sphere.radiance.shadow: Self-righteousness, burning nuance, humiliating the impure, or confusing brightness with virtue.
tianxia.sphere.radiance.keep_distinct_from: Light is optical visibility and precision. Sun is solar endurance and authority. Fire burns with heat. Yang is active vitality. Radiance is spiritual purification and revealed truth.
tianxia.sphere.radiance.gm_read: Radiance is spiritual brilliance and cleansing pressure. It is tested by hidden danger, compassion, and restraint.

tianxia.sphere.retribution.name: Retribution
tianxia.sphere.retribution.reality_principle: Every committed action already has an answer waiting for it.
tianxia.sphere.retribution.dao_trail: The character waits for the enemy to commit, reads tells, holds a strike ready, and punishes repeated mistakes more severely than the first.
tianxia.sphere.retribution.trial_signs: Lets an opponent overextend, counters instead of attacking first, interrupts a ritual at the last moment, answers a betrayal precisely.
tianxia.sphere.retribution.shadow: Vindictiveness, passivity disguised as patience, grudges, or punishing more than the offense deserves.
tianxia.sphere.retribution.keep_distinct_from: Karma makes consequence return over time. Guardian interposes. Sabers makes its own opening. Retribution answers at the moment of commitment.
tianxia.sphere.retribution.path_pull: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.retribution.gm_read: Retribution is the prepared answer. It is tested by enemies who never commit, by situations that demand initiative, and by forgiveness.
tianxia.sphere.retribution.basis: Compendium "Retribution Dao" ("the cultivation of the prepared answer").

tianxia.sphere.sabers.name: Sabers
tianxia.sphere.sabers.reality_principle: Hesitation is an opening, and the saber makes one.
tianxia.sphere.sabers.dao_trail: The character closes distance, takes the outside gate, chops through hesitation, and pursues the wounded rather than letting them leave the cut.
tianxia.sphere.sabers.trial_signs: Charges before the defense is ready, breaks a shield line, pursues a fleeing rival, chooses the practical answer over the elegant one.
tianxia.sphere.sabers.shadow: Cruelty, ruthlessness toward the fallen, pursuit that never stops, or contempt for any answer that is not a cut.
tianxia.sphere.sabers.keep_distinct_from: Sword is will refined into severance. The Piercing Needle measures the perfect opening. Axes split joined things. Blood commands wounds. Sabers command the offensive line that made the wound.
tianxia.sphere.sabers.path_pull: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.sabers.gm_read: Sabers ends the discussion by crossing the distance. It is tested by receptivity, by hidden danger the charge cannot see, and by moments that call for stopping.
tianxia.sphere.sabers.basis: Compendium "Sabers Dao" ("Sabers cultivate the brutal line"; verbs Advance, Chop, Wrap, Pursue).

tianxia.sphere.sand.name: Sand
tianxia.sphere.sand.reality_principle: Permanence can be worn down grain by grain.
tianxia.sphere.sand.dao_trail: The character trusts erosion, shifting ground, burial, dryness, patience, and countless small pressures.
tianxia.sphere.sand.trial_signs: Undermines a wall, blinds a pursuer, survives desert hardship, changes the battlefield with small particles.
tianxia.sphere.sand.shadow: Resentment, slow suffocation, reducing monuments to dust because they dared to stand.
tianxia.sphere.sand.keep_distinct_from: Earth is solid ground. Glass is refined sand. Air carries particles. Time ages. Ash is burned remnant. Sand is erosion, grit, dunes, and burial.
tianxia.sphere.sand.gm_read: Sand wears permanence down grain by grain. It is tested by heat, exchange, and sudden storm.

tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.name: Scoundrel
tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.reality_principle: Rules, pride, and terrain are all openings.
tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.dao_trail: The character uses overlooked tools, cheap shots, feints, pocket sand, escape routes, and dirty teamwork.
tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.trial_signs: Finds the hidden latch, distracts the judge, turns a broken bowl into leverage, survives by refusing formal exchange.
tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.shadow: Betrayal, cowardice dressed as pragmatism, bullying the vulnerable, or losing all sense of honor.
tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.keep_distinct_from: Monkey Style is expressive disorder. Shadow hides in angles. Illusion fools senses. Scoundrel is practical exploitation of the immediate situation.
tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.scoundrel.gm_read: Scoundrel sees the opening everyone else is too proud to use. It is tested by honor, exposure, and boundaries that cannot be bypassed without becoming corrupt.

tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.name: Sect Stewardship
tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.reality_principle: A sect is the ledger of who carried whom.
tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.dao_trail: The character organizes, records, remembers names, distributes resources fairly, teaches, and treats duty to the community as cultivation.
tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.trial_signs: Organizes frightened candidates into tasks, remembers a servant's name, shares a stipend, keeps a fair ledger.
tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.shadow: Bureaucracy, favoritism, petty authority, or valuing the institution over its people.
tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.keep_distinct_from: Warleader commands in battle. Formations arrange place. Karma records consequence. Ink records reality. Sect Stewardship tends the living institution.
tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.gm_read: Sect Stewardship keeps the ledger of who fed whom. It is tested by crisis, by hidden corruption, and by authority that would override fairness.
tianxia.sphere.sect_stewardship.basis: Compendium opening quote ("A sect is ... the ledger of who fed whom") and Common Effects.

tianxia.sphere.shadow.name: Shadow
tianxia.sphere.shadow.reality_principle: Every form creates a hidden double.
tianxia.sphere.shadow.dao_trail: The character uses silhouettes, ambush, pursuit, imitation, shadow travel, and the angles created by light.
tianxia.sphere.shadow.trial_signs: Pins a creature through its shadow, follows hidden movement, attacks from an unexpected side, uses a silhouette as clue.
tianxia.sphere.shadow.shadow: Parasitism, fear of being seen, living as someone's darker echo.
tianxia.sphere.shadow.keep_distinct_from: Darkness hides the battlefield. Illusion fakes sensory data. Puppetry controls proxies. Spirit moves souls. Shadow weaponizes cast shape, hidden angle, and pursuit.
tianxia.sphere.shadow.gm_read: Shadow weaponizes the hidden double created by light. It is tested by open authority, exchange, and fixed boundaries.

tianxia.sphere.shield.name: Shield
tianxia.sphere.shield.reality_principle: Defense is an action; the shield goes out to meet the blow.
tianxia.sphere.shield.dao_trail: The character meets attacks actively, angles and deflects, bashes and advances behind cover, and carries protection forward.
tianxia.sphere.shield.trial_signs: Deflects an arrow from an ally, advances behind a raised door, turns a charge aside, holds the front of a line.
tianxia.sphere.shield.shadow: Stubborn confrontation, hiding behind the shield, or protecting only oneself.
tianxia.sphere.shield.keep_distinct_from: Guardian becomes a wall with the body. Protection raises barriers. Equipment wears armor well. Shield is active defense that moves.
tianxia.sphere.shield.path_pull: Body Refining, sometimes Qi or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.shield.gm_read: Shield goes out to meet the blow. It is tested by subtle attacks that go around, by hidden danger, and by trust that asks it to lower.
tianxia.sphere.shield.basis: Compendium opening quote ("A wall waits for the blow. A shield goes out to meet it.") and Common Effects.

tianxia.sphere.smoke.name: Smoke
tianxia.sphere.smoke.reality_principle: What cannot be seen cannot be easily answered.
tianxia.sphere.smoke.dao_trail: The character screens movement, escapes, signals, confuses senses, and uses obstruction as active defense.
tianxia.sphere.smoke.trial_signs: Covers an ally's retreat, hides a stolen key, creates confusion to reset a losing situation.
tianxia.sphere.smoke.shadow: Avoidance, choking others with uncertainty, hiding harm inside confusion.
tianxia.sphere.smoke.keep_distinct_from: Mist conceals gently and cools. Darkness invokes fear and absence. Poison harms biologically. Fire produces heat. Smoke is mobile obstruction, choking cloud, and battlefield screen.
tianxia.sphere.smoke.gm_read: Smoke makes obstruction active. It is tested by honest exchange, command, and containment.

tianxia.sphere.sniper.name: Sniper
tianxia.sphere.sniper.reality_principle: Distance was never protection; one correct line ends the argument.
tianxia.sphere.sniper.dao_trail: The character waits in stillness, reads lines, finds the weak point, and spends one decisive shot rather than many.
tianxia.sphere.sniper.trial_signs: Holds fire until the right moment, hits the rope holding the bridge, disarms from afar, picks the one target that ends the fight.
tianxia.sphere.sniper.shadow: Coldness, detachment, killing without facing the cost, or waiting until the moment is lost.
tianxia.sphere.sniper.keep_distinct_from: Barrage fills the distance. Stars target across great distance. The Hidden Eye studies without shooting. Sniper proves distance was never protection.
tianxia.sphere.sniper.path_pull: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.sniper.gm_read: Sniper makes distance intimate. It is tested by chaos at close range, by exchanges that need presence, and by allies who need support more than a kill.
tianxia.sphere.sniper.basis: Compendium "Sniper Dao" ("distance made intimate"; Stillness, Line, Weak Point, Patience, Arrival).

tianxia.sphere.sound.name: Sound
tianxia.sphere.sound.reality_principle: Vibration reveals, shatters, silences, and connects.
tianxia.sphere.sound.dao_trail: The character listens, communicates, disrupts, echoes, silences, or breaks structures through resonance.
tianxia.sphere.sound.trial_signs: Finds a hollow wall by echo, shatters a lock, calls allies through danger, creates silence at the right moment.
tianxia.sphere.sound.shadow: Noise as domination, careless revelation, weaponized speech, or fear of quiet.
tianxia.sphere.sound.keep_distinct_from: Music shapes emotion and rhythm. Air carries pressure and breath. Weather creates thunderstorm systems. Sound is vibration, resonance, silence, and sonic force.
tianxia.sphere.sound.gm_read: Sound is vibration, communication, and disruption. It is tested by silence, hidden depth, and clarity.

tianxia.sphere.source.name: Source
tianxia.sphere.source.reality_principle: Power sleeps under stone, and what is buried remembers why.
tianxia.sphere.source.dao_trail: The character reads veins and sealed stone, judges whether a bright thing is treasure or trap, stabilizes what is opened, and refuses the greed that opens everything.
tianxia.sphere.source.trial_signs: Recognizes a sealed stone, warns against opening a vault, finds the spirit vein, reinforces a collapsing tunnel.
tianxia.sphere.source.shadow: Greed, opening every bright thing, digging up what should stay buried, or hoarding the earth's wealth.
tianxia.sphere.source.keep_distinct_from: Earth holds ground. Metal refines material. Harvesting gathers from the surface. Formations anchor place. Source reads and seals buried origin.
tianxia.sphere.source.path_pull: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening; Body Refining through stone-bone variants.
tianxia.sphere.source.gm_read: Source asks what the land carries and whether the bright thing is treasure, bait, or prison. It is tested by exposure, by temptation, and by sudden collapse.
tianxia.sphere.source.basis: Compendium "Source Dao" ("the Dao of buried origin").

tianxia.sphere.space.name: Space
tianxia.sphere.space.dao_trail: The character teleports, folds paths, creates portals, stores objects, seals dimensions, or escapes by refusing ordinary distance.
tianxia.sphere.space.trial_signs: Crosses an impossible gap, rescues someone through a fold, locks a route, stores what should not fit.
tianxia.sphere.space.shadow: Evasion, trespass, detachment, or treating closeness as a flaw to be solved.
tianxia.sphere.space.keep_distinct_from: Gravity governs relation and weight. Void governs absence. Air travels through distance. Formations can lock space. Space changes where things are and how far apart they remain.
tianxia.sphere.space.gm_read: Space makes distance negotiable. It is tested by rootedness, danger, and relationships that require closeness.

tianxia.sphere.spear.name: Spear
tianxia.sphere.spear.reality_principle: Intention can travel through a single unbroken line.
tianxia.sphere.spear.dao_trail: The character controls reach, formation, timing, and commitment. They pierce through confusion by choosing direction and holding it.
tianxia.sphere.spear.trial_signs: Keeps danger at distance, guards a crossing, leads from a point, uses one clean thrust to solve a tangled problem.
tianxia.sphere.spear.shadow: Rigidity, overextension, militarized thinking, or reducing every conflict to a charge.
tianxia.sphere.spear.keep_distinct_from: Fencing is close measure and duel pressure. Sword is willful severance. War commands groups. Spear is the disciplined line between self and world.
tianxia.sphere.spear.gm_read: Spear is disciplined direction. It is tested by subtlety, social exchange, and situations where the straight line is not enough.

tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.name: Spirit Companions
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.reality_principle: A spirit is a living answer to something older than the one who binds it.
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.dao_trail: The character acknowledges, bargains with, hosts, and befriends spirits, asks what they want, and accepts sharing their nature.
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.trial_signs: Makes offerings to a local spirit, frees a bound ghost, negotiates rather than commands, carries an ancestor's presence.
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.shadow: Binding spirits against their will, possession, dependency, or losing oneself to the being within.
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.keep_distinct_from: Beastmastery bonds with living beasts. Puppetry commands constructs. Death governs the dead. Spirit Companions is relationship with spirits that already have meaning.
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.path_pull: Spirit Awakening, sometimes Qi or Body.
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.gm_read: Spirit Companions touch a Dao that was walking before the cultivator arrived. It is tested by the urge to command, by boundaries between self and spirit, and by sudden possession.
tianxia.sphere.spirit_companions.basis: Compendium Sphere Dao ("relationship with powers that already have meaning"; "not control").

tianxia.sphere.stars.name: Stars
tianxia.sphere.stars.reality_principle: Distant lights orient the lost and remember the long road.
tianxia.sphere.stars.dao_trail: The character navigates, marks constellations, thinks at long range, reads celestial memory, and trusts distant guidance.
tianxia.sphere.stars.trial_signs: Finds direction at night, marks a target by starlight, remembers an ancient pattern, chooses the path aligned with the sky.
tianxia.sphere.stars.shadow: Aloofness, fatalism, seeing people as tiny points, or mistaking distance for wisdom.
tianxia.sphere.stars.keep_distinct_from: Divination reads omens broadly. Fate nudges possibility. Space governs distance. Light illuminates near reality. Stars govern navigation, constellations, astral memory, and distant targeting.
tianxia.sphere.stars.gm_read: Stars guide from distance and memory. It is tested by earthly duty, community, and falling-star disruption.

tianxia.sphere.sword.name: Sword
tianxia.sphere.sword.reality_principle: Will can become a cutting law.
tianxia.sphere.sword.dao_trail: The character seeks clarity, severance, refinement, decisive action, and the expression of self through blade or blade-like intent.
tianxia.sphere.sword.trial_signs: Cuts the knot, chooses one path cleanly, refuses muddy compromise, awakens killing intent or protective sword intent.
tianxia.sphere.sword.shadow: Obsession, reducing every problem to something to cut, emotional severance, or worship of personal sharpness.
tianxia.sphere.sword.keep_distinct_from: Fencing is duel measure. Metal shapes material weapons. Void unmakes. Sword is will refined into severance.
tianxia.sphere.sword.path_pull: Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, or Spirit Awakening depending on version.
tianxia.sphere.sword.gm_read: Sword is will refined into severance. It is tested by compassion, uncertainty, and exchange that cannot be solved by cutting.

tianxia.sphere.talismans.name: Talismans
tianxia.sphere.talismans.reality_principle: A single prepared stroke can hold Heaven's command.
tianxia.sphere.talismans.dao_trail: The character plans contingencies, stores power in media, crafts portable answers, and values activation discipline.
tianxia.sphere.talismans.trial_signs: Prepares a charm before entering danger, gives an ally a ward, solves a crisis with something made earlier.
tianxia.sphere.talismans.shadow: Hoarding, dependence on consumables, false confidence, or reducing cultivation to stored shortcuts.
tianxia.sphere.talismans.keep_distinct_from: Ink creates ongoing marks and living script. Alchemy changes bodies through pills. Formations shape areas. Talismans are portable written commands waiting to be released.
tianxia.sphere.talismans.gm_read: Talismans hold Heaven's command in a prepared medium. It is tested by malfunction, sudden timing, and dependency on stored answers.

tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.name: The Hidden Eye
tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.reality_principle: Every movement reveals something to the one who is watching.
tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.dao_trail: The character observes before acting, tracks, studies opponents, notices the detail that matters, and turns knowledge into the decisive opening.
tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.trial_signs: Reads a trail others walked past, spots the ambush, studies a rival before the duel, notices the lie in a smile.
tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.shadow: Paranoia, voyeurism, treating people as puzzles to be solved, or waiting so long to act that knowledge becomes useless.
tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.keep_distinct_from: Shadow stalks through angles. Illusion hides the truth. Karma reads consequence. Sniper acts on one line. The Hidden Eye finds the detail that decides everything.
tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.gm_read: The Hidden Eye turns information into decision. It is tested by chaos too fast to study, by commands that demand action now, and by open exchanges where watching is not enough.
tianxia.sphere.the_hidden_eye.basis: Compendium Sphere introduction ("the cultivation of decisive information").

tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.name: The Piercing Needle
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.reality_principle: The duel is won at the one place strength cannot answer.
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.dao_trail: The character measures distance, feints, provokes mistakes, binds and ripostes, and seeks the exact opening rather than the heavy blow.
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.trial_signs: Studies an opponent before moving, disarms rather than kills, wins by timing rather than strength, chooses the narrow path.
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.shadow: Arrogance, tunnel vision, obsession with worthy duels, or disdain for messy realities.
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.keep_distinct_from: Sword is will-shaped severance. Sabers commits to the brutal line. Pressure Points taps the body's hinges. The Piercing Needle is the intimate science of measure and the perfect opening.
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.path_pull: Body Refining, with Qi or Spirit through refined intent.
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.gm_read: The Piercing Needle seeks the exact line where action becomes decisive. It is tested by uncertainty, social misdirection, and situations where no clean duel exists.
tianxia.sphere.the_piercing_needle.basis: Adapted from the owner's First Pass "Fencing" entry; the compendium's Piercing Needle is the precision duelist Sphere (measure, feints, exact strikes, binds, parries, ripostes) and its opening quote.

tianxia.sphere.thread.name: Thread
tianxia.sphere.thread.reality_principle: The subtle line controls the room before anyone notices it exists.
tianxia.sphere.thread.dao_trail: The character prepares hidden connections, uses tension, traps, precise cuts, mobility lines, and delicate manipulation.
tianxia.sphere.thread.trial_signs: Sets a tripline, pulls a tool from across the room, notices unseen connections, wins through careful positioning.
tianxia.sphere.thread.shadow: Manipulation, paranoia, strangling freedom, or treating relationships as strings to pull.
tianxia.sphere.thread.keep_distinct_from: Chains are obvious restraint and anchoring. Puppetry delegates agency into constructs. Fate uses threads of possibility. Thread is subtle physical or spiritual linework.
tianxia.sphere.thread.path_pull: Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, or Spirit Awakening depending on version.
tianxia.sphere.thread.gm_read: Thread controls through subtle lines. It is tested by exposure, disruption, and direct force.

tianxia.sphere.trap.name: Trap
tianxia.sphere.trap.reality_principle: Danger can be taught to wait.
tianxia.sphere.trap.dao_trail: The character studies routes and habits, prepares the ground, lures pursuit, and lets consequence arrive where the enemy assumed safety.
tianxia.sphere.trap.trial_signs: Sets a snare on the path, rigs an alarm, leads a beast into a pit, prepares the room before the enemy arrives.
tianxia.sphere.trap.shadow: Paranoia, cruelty through hidden harm, harming innocents who stumble into prepared danger, or fear of open confrontation.
tianxia.sphere.trap.keep_distinct_from: Formations make whole areas obey pattern. Thread uses lines and tension. Talismans store commands. The Hidden Eye studies without preparing harm. Trap is prepared consequence waiting in place.
tianxia.sphere.trap.path_pull: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.trap.gm_read: Trap teaches danger to wait. It is tested by enemies who do not follow the expected route, by sudden confrontation, and by exposure of hidden harm.
tianxia.sphere.trap.basis: Compendium "Trap Dao" ("the cultivation of prepared consequence").

tianxia.sphere.unmaking.name: Unmaking
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.reality_principle: Existence is an agreement, and every agreement can be broken at a price.
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.dao_trail: The character channels ruinous force, erases barriers and constructs, and pays in their own flesh or tools for power beyond safe limits.
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.trial_signs: Destroys a ward that could not be broken, sacrifices a weapon to end a threat, bears black veins without complaint, chooses a costly answer when no safe one exists.
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.shadow: Self-destruction, nihilism, unmaking what should be healed, or spending others as the channel.
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.keep_distinct_from: Destruction breaks what exists. Void nullifies and removes presence. Daemonic Cultivation steals growth. Unmaking attacks cohesion itself and always demands a channel.
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.path_pull: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening; Body Refining through dangerous channeling.
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.gm_read: Unmaking is dangerous because it works. It is tested by the need to preserve, by restraint, and by those who would pay its price in the cultivator's place.
tianxia.sphere.unmaking.basis: Compendium Sphere Dao ("Unmaking attacks the agreement that lets a thing continue existing").

tianxia.sphere.verdant_growth.name: Verdant Growth
tianxia.sphere.verdant_growth.dao_trail: The character roots, nurtures, regenerates, shapes living terrain, builds cultivation sites, and wins through long persistence.
tianxia.sphere.verdant_growth.trial_signs: Plants a seed for later, uses roots to stabilize, creates shelter, thinks in seasons instead of moments.
tianxia.sphere.verdant_growth.shadow: Invasive control, overgrowth, choking patience, or refusing to let anything be cleared.
tianxia.sphere.verdant_growth.keep_distinct_from: Flowers are bloom, fragrance, and beauty. Life restores bodies. Earth is stable terrain. Flesh is living tissue. Wood is roots, trees, ecology, and cultivated growth.
tianxia.sphere.verdant_growth.path_pull: Qi Cultivation, sometimes Body or Spirit.
tianxia.sphere.verdant_growth.gm_read: Wood is patient growth and living structure. It is tested by shock, fire, and rot or hidden danger.

tianxia.sphere.void.name: Void
tianxia.sphere.void.reality_principle: Absence is not empty; it is the principle by which things cease.
tianxia.sphere.void.dao_trail: The character nullifies, erodes techniques, removes presence, creates gaps, silences power, and understands the terror of nothing answering back.
tianxia.sphere.void.trial_signs: Cancels a trap, leaves no trace, answers overwhelming force by making it fail to exist, stands calmly before annihilation.
tianxia.sphere.void.shadow: Nihilism, emotional hollowing, unmaking what should be healed, or taking comfort in erasure.
tianxia.sphere.void.keep_distinct_from: Space changes distance. Darkness hides. Death ends life. Destruction breaks. Void removes, nullifies, erodes, and creates absence.
tianxia.sphere.void.gm_read: Void is absence as active principle. It is tested by connection, support, and awakening into being rather than erasure.

tianxia.sphere.warleader.name: Warleader
tianxia.sphere.warleader.reality_principle: Many wills can become one blade through command and purpose.
tianxia.sphere.warleader.dao_trail: The character coordinates groups, reads battlefields, gives orders, protects morale, and thinks in formations of living people.
