tianxia.sphere.warleader.trial_signs: Organizes frightened candidates, assigns roles, chooses strategy over personal glory, turns a crowd into a unit.
tianxia.sphere.warleader.shadow: Treating people as pieces, glory through casualties, command addiction, or sacrificing souls for elegant plans.
tianxia.sphere.warleader.keep_distinct_from: Music moves morale through rhythm. Formations create fixed arrays. Guardian protects a line or person. War directs living force at scale.
tianxia.sphere.warleader.path_pull: Qi Cultivation, Body Refining, or Spirit Awakening depending on expression.
tianxia.sphere.warleader.gm_read: War turns many wills into one blade. It is tested by morale, uncertainty, and restraint.

tianxia.sphere.water.name: Water
tianxia.sphere.water.reality_principle: Form survives by adapting to vessel, pressure, and flow.
tianxia.sphere.water.dao_trail: The character cleanses, adapts, redirects, erodes, supports, and finds the low path around resistance.
tianxia.sphere.water.trial_signs: Crosses through current, purifies a stain, uses pressure to move an obstacle, changes plan without losing purpose.
tianxia.sphere.water.shadow: Passivity, emotional flooding, refusal to hold shape, or drowning others in accommodation.
tianxia.sphere.water.keep_distinct_from: Flowing River is martial redirection. Mist is vapor. Cold freezes. Weather makes rain and storm systems. Water is fluid mass, cleansing, pressure, and adaptability.
tianxia.sphere.water.gm_read: Water survives by adapting to vessel and pressure. It is tested by heat, boundary, and command.

tianxia.sphere.wax.name: Wax
tianxia.sphere.wax.reality_principle: What yields takes the impression, and what takes the impression remembers.
tianxia.sphere.wax.dao_trail: The character molds and seals, preserves impressions, makes masks and effigies, and uses yielding form to hold what force cannot.
tianxia.sphere.wax.trial_signs: Seals a letter against tampering, takes an impression of a key, preserves a body for burial, sticks a pursuer fast.
tianxia.sphere.wax.shadow: Imitation of identity, sympathetic harm through effigies, preserving what should be allowed to end, or melting away under pressure.
tianxia.sphere.wax.keep_distinct_from: Ink records through script. Glass is brittle clarity. Earth holds firm. Death governs endings. Wax is yielding form that seals, preserves, and remembers shape.
tianxia.sphere.wax.gm_read: Wax yields in order to hold. It is tested by heat and force, by authority it cannot shape, and by hidden depths it cannot seal.
tianxia.sphere.wax.basis: Compendium Sphere Type, Common Effects and Core Chassis (yielding form, impressions, sealing, molded barriers, effigies).

tianxia.sphere.weapons.name: Weapons
tianxia.sphere.weapons.reality_principle: Every moment has a right shape, and the right weapon answers it.
tianxia.sphere.weapons.dao_trail: The character reads what the moment requires, changes tools without losing intention, and treats each weapon's nature as knowledge.
tianxia.sphere.weapons.trial_signs: Picks up the right tool for the problem, switches weapons mid-fight, uses an unfamiliar weapon well, teaches another how their weapon wants to move.
tianxia.sphere.weapons.shadow: Collecting without mastering, indecision, or valuing the tool over the purpose.
tianxia.sphere.weapons.keep_distinct_from: Sword, Sabers, Spear, and Axes each commit to one form. Metal forges weapons. Equipment wears protection. Weapons is the Dao of the right form for the moment.
tianxia.sphere.weapons.path_pull: Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, and Spirit Awakening.
tianxia.sphere.weapons.gm_read: Weapons wins by changing tools without losing intention. It is tested by situations with no tool, by hidden danger, and by moments that ask for one committed form.

tianxia.sphere.weather.name: Weather
tianxia.sphere.weather.reality_principle: No life stands outside the surrounding pattern.
tianxia.sphere.weather.dao_trail: The character shapes conditions, reads atmosphere, manages battlefield mood, and uses persistent environmental control.
tianxia.sphere.weather.trial_signs: Calls rain, rides storm wind, uses fog and thunder together, changes the whole trial field instead of one target.
tianxia.sphere.weather.shadow: Volatility, making everyone live under the cultivator's storm, confusing mood with mandate.
tianxia.sphere.weather.keep_distinct_from: Air is local wind and breath. Lightning is direct shock. Water is fluid. Cold is freezing. Weather is the living system of sky, pressure, rain, and storm.
tianxia.sphere.weather.gm_read: Weather is the surrounding pattern. It is tested by mountain boundaries, authority, and the effects of storm on community.

tianxia.sphere.wrestling.name: Wrestling
tianxia.sphere.wrestling.reality_principle: Freedom and defeat are often decided at the point of contact.
tianxia.sphere.wrestling.dao_trail: The character closes distance, controls position, pins threats, escapes restraints, and understands leverage over raw power.
tianxia.sphere.wrestling.trial_signs: Grapples the beast instead of striking it, pins a rival without killing, uses a fall to gain position, frees someone from chains by body leverage.
tianxia.sphere.wrestling.shadow: Domination, possessive restraint, humiliation through control, or never letting others move freely.
tianxia.sphere.wrestling.keep_distinct_from: Brute breaks and throws through power. Chains restrain at range or through links. Wrestling is living leverage, contact, and positional truth.
tianxia.sphere.wrestling.gm_read: Wrestling finds truth at the point of contact. It is tested by subtle influence, exposure, and sudden changes that break positional control.

tianxia.sphere.yang.name: Yang
tianxia.sphere.yang.reality_principle: Life advances through heat, motion, assertion, and growth.
tianxia.sphere.yang.dao_trail: The character surges forward, strengthens the body, radiates vitality, rejects stagnation, and treats action as medicine.
tianxia.sphere.yang.trial_signs: Warms the freezing, powers through exhaustion, makes growth burst from pressure, chooses active risk over safe waiting.
tianxia.sphere.yang.shadow: Burnout, overbearing force, devouring ambition, or calling aggression life.
tianxia.sphere.yang.keep_distinct_from: Fire is flame and ignition. Sun is sovereign solar pressure. Life preserves systems. Radiance purifies. Yang is active vitality, heat, growth, and bodily force.
tianxia.sphere.yang.path_pull: Qi Cultivation or Body Refining, rare Spirit expression.
tianxia.sphere.yang.gm_read: Yang is active vitality and heat. It is tested by receptivity, danger, and restraint.

tianxia.sphere.yin.name: Yin
tianxia.sphere.yin.reality_principle: Rest, secrecy, endings, and stillness are half of Heaven.
tianxia.sphere.yin.dao_trail: The character suppresses, conceals, waits, chills, withers, preserves, and trusts quiet over assertion.
tianxia.sphere.yin.trial_signs: Silences a hazard, hides a wounded ally, lets a flame die, accepts an ending without panic.
tianxia.sphere.yin.shadow: Stagnation, isolation, resentment, cold control, or mistaking absence of motion for peace.
tianxia.sphere.yin.keep_distinct_from: Darkness is unseen fear and concealment. Cold is freezing and preservation. Death is mortality. Moon is cycle. Yin is quiet, suppression, rest, decay-adjacent stillness, and secret power.
tianxia.sphere.yin.gm_read: Yin is the quiet half of Heaven: rest, ending, stillness, secrecy. It is tested by exposure, movement, and assertion.

Bones.name: Bones
Bones.dao_trail: The character values internal strength, frameworks, armor, skeletal support, and the architecture beneath living motion.
Bones.trial_signs: Builds a brace, protects the spine of a plan, uses remains respectfully, reinforces a breaking structure, chooses hard support over flexible recovery.
Bones.shadow: Rigidity, deathly aesthetics without reverence, reducing people to useful frames, or fearing softness.
Bones.keep_distinct_from: Earth is external terrain and stone. Metal is refined material. Flesh is living tissue and growth. Bones are internal structure, marrow, and enduring frame.
Bones.gm_read: Bones are structure beneath motion. The sphere is tested by flexibility, peril, and visible truth that may expose what the frame hides.

Crystal.name: Crystal
Crystal.reality_principle: Order grows through lattice, resonance, and stored clarity.
Crystal.dao_trail: The character values structure, amplification, memory, resonance, geometric thinking, and durable beauty.
Crystal.trial_signs: Builds a resonant pattern, stores energy, solves through symmetry, uses a clear structure to strengthen others.
Crystal.shadow: Brittleness, perfectionism, treating people like patterns, or shattering when the lattice fails.
Crystal.keep_distinct_from: Glass is fragile reflection and cutting panes. Earth is stone. Metal is forged durability. Sound resonates through vibration. Crystal stores and amplifies order.
Crystal.gm_read: Crystal is durable order and stored resonance. It is tested by shock, pressure, and exchange outside the lattice.

Divination.name: Divination
Divination.dao_trail: The character investigates, reads omens, tracks spiritual signatures, asks precise questions, and accepts partial knowledge.
Divination.trial_signs: Studies footprints and stars, asks what is missing, finds the hidden object, prepares because of an omen.
Divination.shadow: Paralysis, spying, false certainty, or confusing a glimpse with the whole truth.
Divination.keep_distinct_from: Fate nudges probability. Karma tracks consequence. Stars orient through celestial patterns. Time governs sequence. Divination reads signs and hidden information.
Divination.gm_read: Divination reads signs before certainty. It is tested by limits, mandate, and misinformation from social exchange.

Fencing.name: Fencing
Fencing.reality_principle: A single line, step, or opening can decide the whole exchange.
Fencing.dao_trail: The character measures distance, waits for the precise moment, provokes mistakes, and seeks clean decisive action.
Fencing.trial_signs: Chooses the narrow path, studies an opponent before moving, wins by timing rather than strength, values elegance under pressure.
Fencing.shadow: Arrogance, tunnel vision, obsession with worthy duels, or disdain for messy realities.
Fencing.keep_distinct_from: Sword is will-shaped severance and broader sword intent. Spear controls a longer battlefield line. Fencing is the intimate science of measure, pressure, and the perfect opening.
Fencing.path_pull: Body Refining, with Qi or Spirit through refined intent.
Fencing.gm_read: Fencing seeks the exact line where action becomes decisive. It is tested by uncertainty, social misdirection, and situations where no clean duel exists.

Flesh.name: Flesh
Flesh.dao_trail: The character adapts the body, accepts scars, reshapes weakness, values regeneration, grafting, and survival through organic change.
Flesh.trial_signs: Uses pain as information, seals a wound strangely, accepts a body-altering cost, chooses mutation over death.
Flesh.shadow: Loss of self, exploitation of living matter, body horror without consent, or endless modification to avoid vulnerability.
Flesh.keep_distinct_from: Life restores. Transformation changes form more broadly. Blood carries vitality and lineage. Disease corrupts biological patterns.
Flesh.gm_read: Flesh treats living form as negotiable. It is tested by identity boundaries, exposure, and forceful self-definition.

Light.name: Light
Light.reality_principle: What is seen can be named, measured, and struck.
Light.dao_trail: The character reveals, illuminates, aims precisely, uses optics, color, speed, and visibility to control truth.
Light.trial_signs: Exposes a hidden route, blinds a threat, guides allies with light, refuses to leave danger unnamed.
Light.shadow: Exposure as violence, intolerance of mystery, or confusing visibility with goodness.
Light.keep_distinct_from: Radiance is spiritual brilliance and purification. Sun is solar authority and sustained pressure. Illusion manipulates senses. Glass refracts through material.
Light.gm_read: Light makes things visible and precise. It is tested by hidden danger, boundaries, and humility before what cannot yet be seen.

Mind.name: Mind
Mind.dao_trail: The character reads emotions, commands focus, resists manipulation, uses telepathy, pressures thought, and values discipline.
Mind.trial_signs: Calms panic through words, notices obsession, disrupts concentration, wins by changing what someone attends to.
Mind.shadow: Violation of agency, arrogance, emotional domination, or treating people as problems inside the head.
Mind.keep_distinct_from: Spirit governs souls. Dreams govern subconscious sleep and symbols. Illusion governs senses. War commands groups externally. Mind governs thought, emotion, memory, and attention.
Mind.gm_read: Mind begins with attention. It is tested by stillness, humility, and shock.

Mirrors.name: Mirrors
Mirrors.dao_trail: The character uses reversal, self-confrontation, duplicates, reflective truth, and symbolic images to reveal or redirect.
Mirrors.trial_signs: Makes a rival face their own action, reads a reflection, defeats a lie by showing its source.
Mirrors.shadow: Narcissism, obsession with doubles, reflection traps, or never touching reality directly.
Mirrors.keep_distinct_from: Glass is physical material. Illusion fabricates perception. Moon reflects cycles and quiet power. Shadow is cast double. Mirrors are symbolic reflection, reversal, and self-recognition.
Mirrors.gm_read: Mirrors force reality to meet itself. It is tested by hidden depths, authority, and shattering shock.

Mist.name: Mist
Mist.reality_principle: Softness can conceal, redirect, and recover without becoming false.
Mist.dao_trail: The character avoids hard opposition, hides motion, dampens heat, creates quiet recovery, and moves around obstacles.
Mist.trial_signs: Covers retreat, conceals the wounded, cools a hazard, finds a route no one can clearly see.
Mist.shadow: Evasiveness, vagueness, never being pinned down, or using softness to avoid truth.
Mist.keep_distinct_from: Smoke chokes and confuses. Water has weight and flow. Air moves freely. Darkness hides through absence of light. Mist is vapor, quiet cover, and gentle redirection.
Mist.gm_read: Mist conceals without becoming hard. It is tested by exposure, command, and firm boundaries.

Moon.name: Moon
Moon.reality_principle: Power waxes, wanes, reflects, hides, and returns.
Moon.dao_trail: The character trusts cycles, calm, reflection, tides, sleep, nocturnal perception, and quiet renewal.
Moon.trial_signs: Waits for the right phase, uses reflected light, calms a conflict, transforms under night pressure.
Moon.shadow: Mood instability, passive control, hiding forever, or never acting at full noon.
Moon.keep_distinct_from: Yin is stillness and suppression. Water governs tides as fluid. Mirrors govern reflection as symbolic confrontation. Dreams govern sleep. Moon is cycle, phase, reflection, and quiet power.
Moon.gm_read: Moon is phase, reflection, and quiet return. It is tested by full exposure, authority, and sudden awakening.

Spirit.name: Spirit
Spirit.reality_principle: Form is not the whole person.
Spirit.dao_trail: The character perceives souls, ghosts, possession, spiritual wounds, ancestors, astral boundaries, and the difference between body and self.
Spirit.trial_signs: Talks to a ghost, notices a soul injury, exorcises rather than kills, protects the dead or the unborn self.
Spirit.shadow: Violating spiritual boundaries, obsession with the afterlife, possession, or treating souls as resources.
Spirit.keep_distinct_from: Death governs mortality and corpses. Mind governs thought. Dreams govern subconscious landscapes. Yin governs quiet endings. Spirit governs souls and spiritual identity.
Spirit.gm_read: Spirit knows that form is not the whole person. It is tested by boundaries, authority, and sudden possession or awakening.

Sun.name: Sun
Sun.reality_principle: Sovereign light sustains, exposes, and judges.
Sun.dao_trail: The character acts openly, endures pressure, inspires courage, reveals hidden things, and burns with sustained authority.
Sun.trial_signs: Takes command in daylight, refuses hidden routes, strengthens the frightened, burns away concealment through presence.
Sun.shadow: Tyranny of certainty, pride, scorching everything beneath one's own noon.
Sun.keep_distinct_from: Radiance purifies spiritually. Fire ignites and burns. Yang surges life-force. Light reveals optically. Sun is sustained solar authority, vitality, and judgment.
Sun.gm_read: Sun is sovereign vitality and exposure. It is tested by hidden danger, rest, and humility among others.

Time.name: Time
Time.reality_principle: Sequence is a river with dangerous eddies.
Time.dao_trail: The character delays, accelerates, preserves, anchors moments, reacts before others, or pays for brief correction.
Time.trial_signs: Buys one more breath, preserves evidence, waits exactly long enough, reverses a small disaster at a cost.
Time.shadow: Refusal of consequence, impatience, looping obsession, or treating people as moments to edit.
Time.keep_distinct_from: Fate governs possibility. Sand erodes. Cold preserves through stillness. Stars remember across distance. Time governs sequence, duration, delay, acceleration, and brief rewinds.
Time.gm_read: Time governs sequence and duration. It is tested by exposure, transient joy, and mandate.

Transformation.name: Transformation
Transformation.reality_principle: Identity is tested and revealed through chosen change.
Transformation.dao_trail: The character alters form to meet circumstance, embraces metamorphosis, develops alternate bodies, and treats change as truth rather than disguise.
Transformation.trial_signs: Accepts a strange mark, adapts body to terrain, chooses an uncomfortable change to survive, refuses to remain fixed.
Transformation.shadow: Instability, escaping the self, predatory mutation, or believing all limits are false.
Transformation.keep_distinct_from: Flesh reshapes living tissue. Beast Taming bonds with another creature. Illusion changes appearance or perception. Transformation makes change substantial.
Transformation.path_pull: Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, sometimes Spirit Awakening.
Transformation.gm_read: Transformation makes change substantial. It is tested by boundaries, peril, and the need to receive form rather than endlessly escape it.
